names: Alexandria Center for Science and Technology – 499 Illinois
summary: 499 Illinois Street is a 6-story, ~450,000 sq ft biotechnology building (lab, office, retail, parking) at Mission Bay, developed by Alexandria Real Estate Equities. Both DataSF Assessor records and the project's structural engineer's own page date its completion to 2008.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200607186938 filed to erect the 6-story medical research and biotechnical research facility at this address

sources.title: Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (blklot 3940004, 499 Illinois St): year_property_built 2008

Building Permits: permit #200607186938 (499 Illinois St, block 3940 lot 001 at filing), filed 2006-07-18, "to erect medical research and biotechnical research facility (6 stories)", completed 2009-04-06, estimated cost $90,000,000
sources.publisher: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection

open_questions: Exact month/day of the 2008 completion is not sourced, only the year.

The 2006 construction permit's own block/lot (block 3940, lot 001) differs from the lot the Assessor now uses for this address (lot 004); the address, biotechnical/medical-research-facility description, 6 stories, and $90M cost (matching the scale reported elsewhere for this building) all line up with this parcel, so this is treated as a lot renumbering, not a different building. The permit's own completion sign-off (2009-04-06) also runs slightly later than the Assessor's 2008 year, which may reflect a lag between substantial completion and permit closeout.
